name: openmd-monorepo
description: openmd: interactive Markdown notes. Packages: @openmd/core (renderer), openmd (CLI and live viewer), @openmd/obsidian (Obsidian plugin).
author: siddhant2408

scripts.build: npm run build -w @openmd/obsidian && npm run build -w openmd
scripts.check: esbuild check.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --jsx=automatic --loader:.css=empty --outfile=dist/check.mjs --log-level=warning && node dist/check.mjs && npm run check:regressions && tsc
scripts.check:regressions: esbuild check-regressions.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js='const __dirname = new URL(".", import.meta.url).pathname;' --outfile=dist/check-regressions.mjs --log-level=warning && node --test dist/check-regressions.mjs
